question_text: Describe how you diagnose a computer that randomly shuts down.
expected_answer: You check power supply health overheating signs and failing internal components

question_text: Explain how you identify a failing hard drive.
expected_answer: You look for slow performance clicking sounds and repeated read errors

question_text: Describe how you troubleshoot a monitor that flickers.
expected_answer: You test the cable check the refresh rate and verify the power source stability

question_text: Explain how you diagnose a system that boots but shows no display.
expected_answer: You check GPU seating monitor input selection and cable integrity

question_text: Describe how you identify faulty RAM.
expected_answer: You test with memory diagnostics look for crashes and remove sticks one at a time

question_text: Explain how you troubleshoot a device that disconnects from USB ports.
expected_answer: You test different ports check power draw and inspect the device connector

question_text: Describe how you diagnose a computer with loud or inconsistent fan noise.
expected_answer: You check for dust buildup worn bearings and blocked airflow paths

question_text: Explain how you identify a failing power supply.
expected_answer: You test voltage stability listen for noise and check for random shutdowns

question_text: Describe how you troubleshoot a printer that jams frequently.
expected_answer: You inspect rollers check paper quality and look for worn internal parts

question_text: Explain how you diagnose a laptop that overheats only under load.
expected_answer: You check thermal paste fan performance and airflow restrictions
